**Finding: Compliant** (meets the preferred position — no redline proposed).

- **What I checked:** the fees/payment provision (§5, p0023), the services and exclusivity language (§1, p0001), the term/termination provision (§4, p0016), the disclaimer (§13, p0062), and targeted searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "Exhibit", and "exclusiv".
- **Why compliant:** the deal is a revenue share on actual auction activity — AP pays nothing absent generated revenue. There is no minimum spend, minimum volume, take-or-pay or shortfall penalty binding AP, the arrangement is expressly non-exclusive, and AP remains free to offer Inventory through other agents or third parties. §13 further confirms no minimum revenue level is guaranteed by either Party.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the one-year Initial Term cannot be terminated for convenience and Kubient takes fees generated during any termination period. Those are fees on real revenue rather than a purchase commitment, and exit rights belong to the termination rule — so no double-flagging here.
